---
title: Your first app
description: Scaffold a Calimero app, write its state and methods, test it in-process, and build it to WASM.
---

import { Steps } from '@astrojs/starlight/components';

<Steps>

1. **Scaffold** a crate with `cargo mero`:

   ```bash
   cargo mero new my-app
   cd my-app
   ```

   It writes `Cargo.toml` (the SDK pins, your package id under `[package.metadata.calimero]`, and the build profiles),
   a working `src/lib.rs` with a test, and `GUIDE.md`, the guide the registry asks every package for.

2. **Write the state and methods.** Every app has the same shape: one state struct built from CRDT collections, an
   `init` constructor, calls that take `&mut self`, and views that take `&self`.

   ```rust
   use calimero_sdk::app;
   use calimero_storage::collections::{LwwRegister, UnorderedMap};

   #[app::state(emits = for<'a> Event<'a>)]
   pub struct KvStore {
       items: UnorderedMap<String, LwwRegister<String>>,
   }

   #[app::event]
   pub enum Event<'a> {
       Inserted { key: &'a str, value: &'a str },
   }

   #[app::logic]
   impl KvStore {
       // Runs once, when an instance is created.
       #[app::init]
       pub fn init() -> KvStore {
           KvStore { items: UnorderedMap::new() }
       }

       // A call: changes state, commits on success.
       pub fn set(&mut self, key: String, value: String) -> app::Result<()> {
           app::emit!(Event::Inserted { key: &key, value: &value });
           self.items.insert(key, value.into())?;
           Ok(())
       }

       // A view: reads state, never commits.
       #[app::view]
       pub fn get(&self, key: String) -> app::Result<Option<String>> {
           Ok(self.items.get(&key)?.map(|v| v.get().clone()))
       }
   }
   ```

   Callers pass arguments as JSON, by parameter name: `{"key": "a", "value": "1"}`.

3. **Give each instance its own starting state** by taking arguments in `init`. They are the *init arguments* of
   [an instance](/cloud/deploy/#create-an-instance-for-an-organization), so two organizations' instances of the same
   app can start differently:

   ```rust
   #[app::init]
   pub fn init(title: String) -> Notes {
       Notes { title: LwwRegister::new(title), notes: UnorderedMap::new() }
   }
   ```

   An instance created with `{"title": "Team notes"}` starts with that title. If `init` fails, creating the instance
   fails with `INIT_FAILED` and the app's error.

4. **Test** the logic in-process with `TestHost`, which stands in for the node. Enable the mock store for tests only:

   ```toml
   [dev-dependencies]
   calimero-storage = { workspace = true, features = ["testing"] }
   ```

   ```rust
   #[cfg(test)]
   mod tests {
       use calimero_sdk::testing::TestHost;

       use super::*;

       #[test]
       fn set_then_get() {
           let mut app = TestHost::new(KvStore::init);
           app.call(|s| s.set("k".into(), "v".into())).unwrap();
           assert_eq!(app.view(|s| s.get("k".into())).unwrap(), Some("v".to_owned()));
           assert_eq!(app.events().len(), 1);
       }
   }
   ```

   ```bash
   cargo test
   ```

5. **Build** to WASM. One command compiles, optimizes and embeds the app's ABI (its methods, events and types):

   ```bash
   cargo mero build
   ```

   The module lands at `res/<crate_name>.wasm`. To run it, install it on a [local cluster](/getting-started/) or
   [package and publish it](/build/publish/).

</Steps>
